2025-2026

Provider: Fondazione Agnese e Agostino Maletti

Submission deadline: 30 June 2025

The Agnese and Agostino Maletti Foundation has established several scholarships for the 2025/26 academic year, awarded in the form of non-repayable grants and/or student loans to be reimbursed. These scholarships are intended for Italian citizens enrolled in the programs of the Academy of Architecture in Mendrisio.

Scholarships are generally awarded as a combination of 50% non-repayable grants and 50% student loans.

The scholarships are available to Bachelor students (only in their 2nd or 3rd year) as well as to students enrolled in the Master's program.

Applications must be submitted using the official application form provided by the Foundation and must be received by the Foundation’s office no later than 5:00 p.m. on Friday, September 19, 2025.

• Bachelor in Architettura
  • Master in Architecture
  • Master in Storia e teoria dell’arte e dell’architettura 120
  • Master in Storia e teoria dell’arte e dell’architettura 90
